title: What It Actually Looks Like to Lead When Nobody's Voted You In
caption:
A godly man leads plenty of rooms he was never put in charge of. Leadership starts before the title does.

Take the cost before you take the credit. Apologize first, even when the math says you're only half wrong. Serve the guy who can't do anything for you back. That's leadership with no vote attached to it.

A title is just other people catching up to what was already true. Go first into the cost. Let the following come find you.

#faith #godlyman #leadership #service #christianmen #discipleship #character
theme: He leads by going first into the cost.
